summary: Negligible overhead. The gate adds one small JSON read (require_task_grill) per WRITE delegation only; read-only lanes are untouched. The board reads the pr-linked event stream once per aggregate/detail — small local files, no hot path, no loop over large data. task_digest is computed once and reused.

non_blocking_findings.summary: pr_links(base) parses events.jsonl in both aggregate_state and story_detail per render; trivial at board scale.
